TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Contested enclave
DATE 13 November 2028 · 0450 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 70 min, closes at 105
KC-130J Hercules. Photo supplied by the SEST author
"Neither air superiority nor victory are American birthrights. Both are at significant risk."
- Gen. Mark Kelly, Commander, Air Combat Command, 2021

THE ENCLAVE, BIAK, before dawn. Local Indonesian authorities have negotiated a seventy-minute window to move civilians and emergency supplies out of the port. The battery covering the approach is an S-400 the first reports called man-portable. Its crews are from the Russian detachment, not Meridian's hard-line faction, which seized the airfield. The battery went dark when the window was agreed; nobody expects it to stay dark, and its radars should be back up within about five minutes.

GRIZZLY, the Growler, has the jamming and the anti-radiation shots, off the US carrier THEODORE ROOSEVELT. DOOM 41 and 42, B-52H with conventional ARRW, have the opening airfield strike. Fire early from the southern launch line; target the military runway and dispersal complexes. They recover to Tindal. Civilian shelters and the power station remain protected. Captain Prasetyo keeps Langgur open for local aircraft. The two relief KC-130Js are holding to the west and will not come in while that radar is up. If the coasters got fuel into Langgur on the tenth, a second KC-46, TEXACO 53, backs up TEXACO 52 on the refuelling tracks south-west of the box. TEXACO 52 is available either way. Langgur also has a modern resident detachment: F-16CMs, a Saab GlobalEye, F-35As, Growlers, P-8s, a KC-46 and Seahawks. THEODORE ROOSEVELT is in the Arafura Sea, south of Papua.

Suppress the battery, put its launcher out of the argument, and let the transports through. You are not levelling a regional industrial complex to do it. Everything on that field that is not shooting at you is somebody's town.

ROOSEVELT AIR OPERATIONS: The carrier has a specified US Navy wing, including six Growlers and US-flagged Super Hornets. Two Growlers are ready for launch. The airborne Growler is also American. Military buildings and detached helicopters destroyed here remain absent in Second Ring; mobile replacement SAMs arrive independently. Destroying the airfield is useful, but the relief movement remains the main task.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.

FORWARD RECON: MOTH 11, a small RQ-7 reconnaissance UAV, joins over the local approach at minute ten, allowing time for initial air-defence suppression. Two reserve UAVs are at the forward recovery section from the start. They are unarmed, have finite fuel and a local recovery field. Use their sensors to classify the military installations and update strike aimpoints. The small airframes are vulnerable; no scripted reveal grants a target solution. Keep a recovery margin and reposition the initial track as needed.
Commodore Alex Mercer
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Protect both relief transports and bring at least one into the safe area before the seventy-minute window closes. Losing either transport ends the operation. Suppress the battery covering their approach while avoiding the civilian buildings. The relief movement takes priority over damage to the airfield.
• Get the relief aircraft through to the safe box
• Neutralise the surface-to-air battery
• Leave the civilian buildings on the field standing
• Disable the military runway complex
• Disable the military dispersal complex
• Obtain a current classification of the land target area

Two B-52H with conventional ARRW and a US Navy Growler; Roosevelt's 66-aircraft US wing, including six Growlers; two relief transports; Texaco 52 and the Langgur detachment. Texaco 53 joins after Weather Alternate. Opposing: S-400, military airfield/dispersal, ballistic launcher and Russian tactical aviation. Civilian buildings are protected. Forward RQ-7 section: two reserve UAVs at a local strip; Moth 11 joins at minute ten.

The planned window is 70 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 35 minutes more; the operation is closed at 105 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
